arms.label: Lower reasoning effort on the whole corpus

caveats.message: Provider cache expiry is not observable; the idle duration is an operator guess recorded here.

notes: The canonical paired campaign: the quality default against a cheaper configuration, across cold, warm and post-idle cache strata. A cheaper arm is recommended when it is non-inferior on the task-clustered paired test and cheaper over the used tasks; per-task regressions are listed, not blocking. Non-inferiority on verified success with an absolute margin of 0.10 (10 points); the margin and the cost ceiling are the owner's to change.
